page.layout: One page of text, full width: two numbered paragraphs (VI and VII) in the upper half; below them, at the right, a catchword line "JOAN-". No margin notes.

main_text.p: VI. Ejufdem per Reformationem, feu feparationem fidelium, fuæ in fpiritualibus & temporalibus dominationis cladem gravifjimam patientis. A Leone X. feu A. C. M. D. XVII. ad Concilii Tridentini finem, feu A. C. M. D. LXIII. ufque.

VII. Ejufdem per decreta falfæ fidei, & anathematifmos Tridentinos in errore obfirmatæ, & cum vera Chrifti Ecclefia fraude & vi continuè decertantis. A tempore finiti Concilii Tridentini, feu A. C. M. D. LXIII. ad noftra ufque tempora.

page.notes: The Roman numerals and "A. C. M. D." dates are printed in small capitals; the "JOAN-" line is set at the right and appears to be a catchword, not a running head. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g., "obfirmatæ", "continuè") but were read as printed.
